description:
Goal
Build BackendProgram(root) from the PullSession inventory after symbolic products have been demanded and produced.

Required shape
- Front door requests RootBackendProduct(root), which pulls BackendExecutable(root entry) and everything transitively named by symbolic local products.
- Final packager sees only session inventory that already exists because products were pulled. It must not call root_executable_frontier or scan world facts to discover executables.
- Assign dense executable indices, atom tables, callable tables, and other interpreter conveniences only in this final product.
- Deterministic sorting is allowed here because semantics and inclusion have already been decided.

Signal
The interpreter consumes the product-built BackendProgram for a focused fixture. Dense index sort is final-only and has no effect on transport, runtime demand, or semantic inclusion.

Removal target
Legacy EmissionReadyProgram becomes unnecessary for the new interp backend path, but deletion waits for the telemetry and legacy-removal tickets.

Verification
A narrow product-path interp test for 00181 or an equivalent fixture; targeted assertions that final packaging has root_scans=0 and follow_ups=0.
title: Pull path: add final BackendProgram packager
